analyst_view.overall: Early view: a straight relegation fight between Konyaspor and Gaziantep, level on eight points after eleven games. Ilhan Palut called Konyaspor's display in the 1-0 loss at Samsunspor very bad, and Gaziantep went into the break after six straight defeats and the exit of coach Orhan Ak. Both have two more league games first, so the table may look different by then.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.3 goals and I lean lower. Konyaspor have scored six in eleven and Gaziantep two in their last seven, and in a game neither can afford to lose, caution should win out.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners. Konyaspor at home should attack down the flanks through Arthur Masuaku and Jean-Luc Dompe, but nothing points clearly away from the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.9 cards and I lean higher. A six-pointer at the bottom with both sides under pressure tends to produce bookings, and Konyaspor had Enis Destan sent off at Samsunspor before VAR reduced it to a yellow.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.4 shots. These are two of the league's least productive attacks, and neither will want to leave space behind, so I lean slightly lower.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.1 shots on target. Konyaspor hit the bar and missed headers at Samsunspor rather than forcing saves, and Gaziantep have scored twice in seven games, so slightly lower.
